dogecoin.text:

Dogecoin mooning like it’s 2021.  
BNB hoarding, Cardano ETF dreaming.  
NFTs back? CryptoPunks laugh at your JPEGs.  
Musk hyping AI, Vitalik ghosting.  
AltSeason or bust, HODL or dust.

Yo, Dogecoin's mooning cause Elon sneezed HODL again  
Shiba Inu barking loud, but it's just meme noise  
Vitalik's cooking Ethereum 2.0, still no cheap gas  
AI coins like AIXBT flexing, yet half are scams  
Crypto bros, keep dreaming - Web3 ain't saving your bags
